answer: Budget the honeypots first: each epoch the network plants tasks whose answer is already known, and any identity returning the planted wrong value gets flagged and its payout frozen. Work is capped per identity per epoch, so volume cannot buy past the cap, and each task's cipher is redrawn per attempt so answers cannot travel between accounts. A cheater copying last round's pigment into a fresh slot is caught by the mismatch. One cheap re-check by an agent with nothing to gain costs less than the farm loses, and a clean lantern of history is the only way back.
